## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-second-source-verification.sh that validates the second-source agent output format and content. Tests must fail before T2 implements the agent.

## Test Cases
1. Agent output confirms typed-enum verifier was used on story (P1 field present in closure artifact) -> exits 0
2. Agent output finds story closed without P1 field (legacy schema) -> exits 1 with finding
3. Agent output confirms renderer used (render-closure-narrative.sh invocation in artifact) -> exits 0
4. Agent output finds closure narrative generated via LLM (not renderer) -> exits 1 with finding
5. Agent output confirms handoff gate enforced between story pair -> exits 0
6. All mechanisms confirmed for all stories -> summary exits 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-second-source-verification.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-second-source-verification.sh
